title: factory: indigo_test/AGENTS.md: document that test binaries and runners use their own checkout's build/lib
description: Agent-instruction part of ticket b2c12d5d, split out so that it lands in a separate factory: commit (AGENTS.md is a Factory artifact under the repository commit rules). Land only after b2c12d5d is on master. Apply exactly the reviewed bullet saved in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-rumen-work-indigo-git/629be5ae-c7a6-4969-bd2c-27ae612f2bf9/scratchpad/b2c_agents.patch to the Makefile Rules list of indigo_test/AGENTS.md (after 'Keep test-specific linker flags local and explicit.'). No other change.

outcome.summary: One accuracy defect in the added bullet (indigo_test/AGENTS.md:322). Its last sentence, 'buildsystem/test_checkout_library.py checks this.', directly follows the Python runner sentence and reads as covering it, but the test does not exercise any Python runner: it only checks that a TEST_LDFLAGS-style binary started directly loads this checkout's libindigo despite a foreign LD_LIBRARY_PATH (test_checkout_library.py:119-124), that indigo_test/Makefile exports this build/lib first in LD_LIBRARY_PATH/DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH (108-117), and that a recipe overrides a foreign path also for a RUNPATH binary (126-136). Nothing inspects run_scheduler_simulators.py or the environment any runner builds. An agent adding a new runner could wrongly assume the convention is enforced. Fix: limit the claim, e.g. 'buildsystem/test_checkout_library.py checks the linking and the Makefile export.' Everything else verified against master: TEST_LDFLAGS carries -Wl,-rpath,$(BUILD_LIB) plus -Wl,--disable-new-dtags on non-Darwin (indigo_test/Makefile:259,266-268), DT_RPATH precedes LD_LIBRARY_PATH, the Makefile exports both variables with BUILD_LIB first (269-270), and run_scheduler_simulators.py:339-340 prepends repo/build/lib to both in the child environment. Placement after 'Keep test-specific linker flags local and explicit.' matches the ticket; English; no contradiction with other rules in the file; diff equals the reviewed patch; commit 72e37b315 is on master.

Round 2: the round-1 finding is fixed; the closing sentence now limits buildsystem/test_checkout_library.py to the linking and the Makefile export (tests at lines 108, 120 and 126) and says the runners are not covered. Every statement re-checked against master 72e37b315. indigo_test/Makefile:258 has the TEST_LDFLAGS rpath, :265-267 has --disable-new-dtags except on Darwin (DT_RPATH, searched before LD_LIBRARY_PATH), and :269-270 exports LD_LIBRARY_PATH and DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH with BUILD_LIB first. integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py:338-340 puts repo/build/lib first in both variables for the indigo_server child. The diff adds one line in the Makefile Rules list after 'Keep test-specific linker flags local and explicit.' and changes nothing else. It differs from scratchpad b2c_agents.patch only by the round-1 wording fix. The whitespace check passed. No defects.
